title: Fewer Purchases, Higher Prices, More Spending
subtitle: Two independently scaled quantitative signals converge on the reported spending outcome without implying that their units are comparable.

relationship.formula: Purchase count × average spend per purchase shapes total spending

data.label: Items purchased
data.detail: Consumers bought fewer clothing and footwear items.

data.label: Average check
data.quantity: average clothing and footwear purchase check

data.label: Nominal spending
data.detail: Higher prices outweighed the fall in purchase volume.

note: The reported measures use slightly different windows, so the connectors show a directional relationship rather than an exact arithmetic reconciliation.

metadata.keyFinding: Falling purchase volume and a higher average check converged on higher nominal spending.
